description: Angular component for displaying and managing a table of calculated field arguments, including sorting, editing, and entity name resolution.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldArgumentsTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a table of calculated field arguments with sorting, editing, and validation features.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldArgumentDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for the calculated field arguments table.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, particularly toggling script mode.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes sorting change subscription after view initialization.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the component is touched.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the arguments form array.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Disables or enables the component.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Removes an argument from the form array.

methods.name: manageArgument
methods.description: Opens a popover to add or edit an argument.

methods.name: updateDataSource
methods.description: Updates the table data source with sorted arguments.

methods.name: updateErrorText
methods.description: Sets validation error messages based on current arguments.

methods.name: getArgumentsObject
methods.description: Converts form array values into an object keyed by argument names.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form array from an external arguments object.

methods.name: getEntityDetailsPageURL
methods.description: Generates URL for entity details page.

methods.name: changeIsScriptMode
methods.description: Updates form validity based on script mode.

methods.name: isEditButtonShowBadge
methods.description: Determines if edit badge should be shown for an argument.

methods.name: populateArgumentsFormArray
methods.description: Fills form array with arguments from an object.

methods.name: updateEntityNameMap
methods.description: Fetches entity names for arguments and updates the map.

methods.name: fetchEntityNames
methods.description: Fetches entity names for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: getSortValue
methods.description: Returns a string value for sorting based on column.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Sorts argument data based on current sort order.
